Loki's Sun\r      Sabik Mining Corporation\r\rScans indicate a bilevel mining\rcolony in operation beneath the\rplanet's surface.  High\rconcentrations of iron and\rneutritium in the soil will make\rit impossible to teletrans from\rsubsurface levels.
A Narrow Thread\r       Sector Communications\r\rSub-arctic temperatures indicated\ron the surface of this planet.\rThis station maintains a prime\rcommunications relay for the\rsector.

Cognito Ergo Sum\r      Ipremi Homeworld (Dead)\r\rThermal and infrared imaging\rindicates a massive complex of\rradioactive ruins. Low level\relectromagnetic interference seems\rto indicate automated machinery in\roperation. A good deal of trading\rtraffic apparently comes through.

Spawn\r         Rutilicus Colony.\r\rAn agricultural colony has been\restablished on the surface of this\rplanet. Settlement patterns\rindicate a central hub of communal\roffices surrounded by homes and\rfields. Cin-Sae Spawn overrun\rlarge portions of this planet.

Of Universal Concern\r          Starport Kochab\r\rRecords indicate that this\rStarport was established by\rtraders dealing with exporters\rfrom Izar Sector.  Surface radio\rcommunications are largely\roccupied with information about an\rauction now in progress.

From the Ruins\r           Detenu\r\rNo significant power radiations\rare detected on the surface of\rthis planet.  Comparison studies\rsuggest a culture closely\rapproximating that of a medieval\rearth.  Contact with this planet\rwas prohibited to the operators of\rthe ETS.

We, the Abducted\r          Mizarian Capital\r\rMizar VI is the seat of the now\rdefunct Mizarian Trading Empire\rwhich controlled nearby stars in\rthe Caroli sector.  Several\rbuildings in the downtown region\rreflect the incredible wealth once\rcontrolled by the Mizarians.  They\rare beaming welcome messages.

Circle of Light\r           Omega Complex\r\rAutomated by an entity known as\rOMEGA, this station has several\rslo-fireships docked in her\rlanding bays. Contact with OMEGA\ror any inhabitants on the planet\rwas strictly forbidden to the ETS.\rNo reason given in ship records.

The Concierge\r              Melchior\r\rPeculiar gravity waves are\remanating from this planet, making\rscans of the planet difficult. A\rcluster of lifeforms located near\rthe disturbance may be\rresponsible.  No other information\ravailable.

A Taste of Id\r        Vindemiatrix Colony.\r\rThis settlement is not entered on\rany list of existing colonies. \rConstruction seems to be underway\ron a number of new structures. A\rbuilding, located in the center of\rthe colony, is surrounded by an\rimpenetrable force-field.

A Small Matter\r           Oortizam Labs\r\rOortizam Labs is a research\rfacility looking into colony\rexpansion problems. A number of\rindependent studies are currently\rin progress by field leaders and\rinnovators. Tours available.\rReasonable rates.

Life Gallery\r         Merak Prime\r\rPreserved in simulated natural\rhabitats, over sixty species of\rwild animals are available for\rviewing in the Life Gallery. A\rproblem has been reported with\rrecent animal thefts.

Desolation\r              Harvest\r\rThis world is strictly an\ragricultural world with carefully\rmaintained fields.  The space\rtraffic controller is requesting\rhelp with a mechanical\rmalfunction.

Forsake the Wind\r           Eldarin Temple\r\rDespite sweltering temperatures on\rthe surface of the planet, a\rnumber of lifeforms seem to be\rgathered around a temple. The\rcomputer advises that the Eldarins\rwill emerge from their hibernation\rcycle soon.

Inauguration Day\r        Presidential Station\r\rThe Algiebians are currently\rcelebrating the second\rinauguration of their president\rIshtao. Security advises that an\rinvitation will be required to\rboard the station.

Solitaire\r             Xixitalis\r\rCaves stretch for kilometers\rbeneath the surface of this\rplanet.  A beam down location is\rindicated fifteen hundred meters\rbelow the surface but no life\rforms or structures are detected\rthere.  Other chambers may exist\rbeyond the reach of the teletrans\ror the beam down location.

If Love Be True\r            Avia Castle\r\rAvia castle is indicated as the\rseat of Avian government.  Despite\rits primitive architecture, the\rstructure is made of a neutritium\renhanced concrete that is designed\rto shed heavy particle beam fire.\rSeveral dignitaries are registered\rin castle rooms.

Gift of the Magin\r              Henresia\r\rScans indicate that eighty percent\rof Subra II is submerged in\rswamplands. A dryspot located near\rseveral supermassive trees is\rindicated as a possible teletrans\rlocation. A low technology river\rculture flourishes here.
When Titans Fall\r             Capella I\r\rThermal imaging displays scattered\rfires burning over a two hundred\rkilometer range. A signal beamed\rfrom the surface may be an alien\rS.O.S.

Catalogue #38791\r       Sector Affairs Office\r\rLong term projections of this\rplanet's orbit indicate that it\rregularly passes through a swarm\rof asteroids, making it unsuitable\rfor large settlements. A single\rlifeform occupies the planet.
Peace Offering\r           Hyades Station\r\rA peace conference is currently\runderway to resolve issues\rinvolving Scroe and Evian\rintrusions into the Alhena Sector.

Squatters\r             Procyon III\r\rEvidently there is some\rdisagreement over the ownership of\rthis planet. Two armies are camped\ron the planet and negotiations are\runderway. The arbitrators do not\rrecommend casual visitors.

Stormy Weather\r            Rasalmothal\r\rMeteorological reports have\rrecently indicated winds gusting\rup to 120 kilometers per hour on\rthe planet surface. People\rtransporting to the building\rplatforms may experience\rdifficulties.

Error Factor 0\r           Zauraki Capital\r\rAloft on special platforms,\rseveral office complexes are\rfloating over the surface of\rRana I. A prime teletrans point\ris indicated on one of the newer\rplatforms.

And Touch The Barren Moon\r         Temple of the Sun\r\rSpectrographic analysis indicates\rthat the local atmosphere is too\rthin to support any known\rlifeforms. The temple built on the\rsurface must have been constructed\rby an extrasolar race.

A Matter of Conscience\r         Library of Zaurak\r\rA three district city is located\rnear the Beam down point.  Long\rfamous for a compiled library of\rover 100 billion volumes of\rvarious media, the Zauraki have\rnow declared their planet and\rtheir library off limits to alien\rvisits.

At the Edge of Twilight\r        Diphda Trade Station\r\rComputer imaging suggests that a\rtrade station is located at the\rbeam down location.  Readings\rindicate a heavy snow pack with\rminimal signs of outdoor\rexcursions.

The Apocalypse Factor\r       Ethnys Imperial Palace\r\rAn insectlike race currently\rpopulates Fomalhaut VI. Any alien\rdealings with the Ethnys must be\rchanneled through the monarch who\rlives in this palace.
Instrument of the Gods\r          Temple of Ankaq\r\rPlanetary readings are impossible\rto confirm due to the\rhyperactivity of the nearby sun.\rExtreme heat is expected on the\rsurface.

Double Blind\r          Utrece Homeworld\r\rNot territorial by nature, the\rUtrece have allowed numerous races\rto build around them but they\rretaliate viciously when attacked.\rA number of collectors come to\rthis world to deal with traders.

A Pearl of Price\r            Nashira III\r\rOver a hundred minor island chains\rthrust through the surface of\rDeneb IV's oceans.  No sentient\rlifeforms are known to occupy the\rplanet, but a beam down location\ris available on one of the smaller\rresort islands.

Shadowside\r             Shadowside\r\rExtremely high levels of carbon\rmonoxide are evident in the local\ratmosphere as are high levels of\rother toxic materials. Visitors\rare advised to limit their\rexposure to this environment.
By Puppet Strings\r          Ominari Embassy\r\rThe Ominar base is apparently\rshielded from scans. High energy\rfluctuations in the upper\ratmosphere seem to indicate\rteletrans activity.

Ghosts, Nightmares & Yesterdays\r           WayPoint Nine\r\rAn energy rift to the starboard\rside of the station is bathing the\rexperimental station with hard\rradiation. A request for help is\rbeing beamed from the station.

First Contact\r        OMEGAN Outpost\r\rA small informational outpost has\rbeen established on a dead moon.\rETS records indicate this as a\rcontact point for observers who\rwere assisting with the failed\rCentauri Drive Experiment. There\rare some signs that indicate that\rthere may still be life here.

Into The Breech\r          Ascella 2\r\rScans indicate an enormous amount\rof electronic activity down there.\rThe complex seems to be completely\rautomated. Movement on the scanners\rcould mean robots, but electromag\rinterference is shielding against\rour scanning attempts.

Sol 1\r              Mercury\r\rScans indicate a heavily cratered \rsurface. This planet has seen a\rlot of action in its day. The \rtemperature ranges from 800\rdegrees on the sunny side to minus\r300 degrees on the dark side. Not\rvery hospitable for us. No life\rforms indicated.
Sol 2\r               Venus\r\rVenus has no msg you sill person\ryou.

Homecoming\r         U.N.F.A. Moonbase\r\rThe U.N.F.A. Moonbase, constructed\roriginally for the purpose of a\rtrip to Mars, now houses the\rresearch and development teams\rthat support the ongoing mission\rto recover the Earth from its\rwormhole trap.

Sol 4\r                Mars\r\rScans indicate thin clouds of \rcondensed carbon dioxide, water \rvapor and dust. If I remember my \rdays at the academy, this means\rthe coming of spring for the red\rplanet.  Not much of real use to\rus down there.

Sol 5\r               Saturn\r\rScans indicate the planet's core to\rbe made up primarily of liquid \rhydrogen, surrounded by three\rlayers of gaseous clouds. This\rplanet is a lot like Jupiter, but\rthe storms are even more violent.\rNo metals indicated. Nothing of\ruse to the mission.

Sol 6\r              Jupiter\r\rScans indicate the planet's core to\rbe made up primarily of liquid \rhydrogen, surrounded by three\rlayers of gaseous clouds. Only a\rsmall portion of the lower\ratmosphere holds a temperature\rrange suitable for our\renvironmental suits. The Jovian\rmagnetosphere prevents teletrans\rand more detailed scans.
Sol 7\r               Uranus\r\rScans indicate a rocky core with\rno heavy metals or life,\rsurrounded by a frozen mantle and\rclouds of Methane ice crystals. No\ruseful materials detected.
Sol 8\r              Neptune\r\rOne of its moons appears to have a\rMethane atmosphere and oceans of \rliquid Nitrogen. Not the prime \rchoice for a vacation. No reason\rfor contact, Captain.

Sol 9\r               Pluto\r\rScans indicate Methane atmosphere \rand frozen Methane surface.\rSurface temperature is minus 350\rdegrees. It's a dark and lonely\rplace.  Nothing of value to the\rmission detected.

Scanning passes indicate no\rsentient lifeforms currently\rinhabiting this planet. Carbon\rchains detected in the atmosphere\rwould seem to indicate that a\ryield of Earthlike Organics could\rbe mined from our ship.

There are sizable deposits of\rEarthlike Organics in this\rplanet's strata. Other sources may\rbe located deeper in the core of\rthe planet but we will have to\rwait until those sources are\rforced to the surface.
Background comparison studies\rindicate high levels of gamma\rradiation coming from the planet.\rSamples beamed from the surface\rseem to suggest the presence of\rEarthlike Radioactives.
Strontium levels in the local\renvironment would make teletrans\rto the surface instantly lethal.\rThe good news is that this world\rnaturally produces large\rquantities of Earthlike\rRadioactives.

The crystals displayed on the\rviewscreen would appear to have\rbeen naturally formed by volcanic\ractivity on the planet's surface.\rWe should be able to mine these\rCrystallines in bulk with the\rship's teletrans.
This planet appears to be a major\rsource of Crystallines.  If its\rcrystal formation rate remains\rconstant, we should be able to\rmine this planet on a regular\rbasis.

We will be unable to beam down to\rthe surface of this world as\rmagnetic effects could disrupt\rteletrans stability. We should be\rable to compensate enough to\rharvest any Heavy Metals that we\rcan detect.

Iron, Copper and Nickel make up\rthe majority of this planet's\rcrust, making it a primary\rproducer for Heavy Metals.\rQuantities are large enough that\rwe should be able to mine here in\rthe future.
Large gaps in the upper atmosphere\rmay be the signature of a major\rInert Gas producer. If we can find\rconcentrated quantities then we\rshould be able to mine here.
No signs of civilization are\revident on this planet. Analysis\rof the atmosphere indicates the\rpresence of Inert Gases which we\rmay be able to mine.
Conditions here are favorable for\rthe formation of Soft Metals like\rgold and lead. There should be no\rdifficulty in mining them directly\rfrom orbit.
Rich veins of Soft Metals are\ralmost visible from orbit. The\rsupply, for our purposes, is\rnearly unlimited.

Ninety seven percent of this\rworld's surface is submerged by a\rsea of peculiar composition.\rWater, alcohol and various other\rCommon Liquids may be suitable for\rour purposes. Beam down will not\rbe necessary.

Small pockets of Common Liquids\rare detectable on the surface of\rthis planet. Although we shouldn't\rhave any problems mining here, I\rsuspect that it will take a while\rbefore this planet can generate\rmore.

An air content analysis indicates\rthat the atmosphere is largely\rcomposed of an Alien Gas whose\rproperties more closely resemble\rplasma than anything else. These\rgases are among the minerals that\rMoonbase has requested we mine.
We are detecting a number of new\relements in gaseous form.  These\rAlien Gases appear to be quite\rabundant and could be extracted\rfrom the atmosphere.
Our scans of the planet surface\rare being reflected back. The\rrecords aboard the ETS indicated\rthat this was sometimes a problem\rwhen scanning worlds with\rconcentrations of Alien Metals.
Judging by the degree of sensor\rdeflection we are encountering,\rthere is a motherload of Alien\rMetals in the crust of this\rplanet. We should literally be\rable to take as much as we can\rcarry!

Severe radiation makes this planet\runsuitable to all forms of life\rknown in this arm of the galaxy.\rThe computer does suggest,\rhowever, that Alien Radioactive\rIsotopes could be mined from\rorbit.
A fury of radioactive activity is\rsweeping the planet, making beam\rdown impossible. We still can\rharvest a king's bounty of Alien\rRadioactive isotopes with little\rdifficulty.
We are detecting a number of\rcompounds not found previously in\rcrystalline form. If mined, we may\rbe able to use these Alien\rCrystals in the Replicator.

At first I thought we were\rreceiving transmissions from the\rplanet but I realized the\rinterference was generated by the\rpresence of Alien Crystals.  We\rshould be able to mine them in\rlarge, steady amounts.
A close analysis of this biosphere\rreveals several unordered\rlifeforms, none evolved enough for\rcommunication. It is possible,\rhowever, that we can distill Alien\rOrganics from the soil.

Judging by the evidence in the\rsoil, this planet must have been\rteeming with life at one time.\rThere's no one to contact now, but\rwe should have an ample supply of\rAlien Organics. We can extract\rthem at a very fast rate.
Although it would seem to be\rcondensing them at a fantastically\rslow rate, this planet could\rprobably generate Alien Liquids if\rgiven sufficient time between\rextraction visits.
Although it would seem to be\rcondensing them at a fantastically\rslow rate, this planet could\rprobably generate Alien Liquids if\rgiven sufficient time between\rextraction visits.
Detecting unusual molecular\rcombinations in the planet's\rcrust. These Uncommon Compounds\rmay be of interest to the\rReplication team back at Moonbase.
This planet seems to fall well\rinto the mid-range Caneghem\rplanetary scale:  moderate\rtemperatures, average orbit. To\rits note, it has huge deposits of\rUncommon Compounds.
We may have a few New Elements to\rname when we return to Moonbase.\rWe are detecting atomic structures\rof incredibly high mass numbers.\rWe may be able to mine them with\rour teletrans.
This planet's atmospheric\rconditions are undoubtedly\rresponsible for the host of New\rElements present here.  Since the\rcrust is still very active, it\rwill generate new supplies\rrapidly.

Scans indicate that the entire \rsurface of this planet is covered \rwith a flow of molten,\rsuperheated, something. I don't\rrecognize the material, but it\rappears to be caught in a state\rjust prior to cooling. The fumes\rare very toxic. Nothing we dare\rbring aboard.

Scans indicate lots of organic\rplant life. All in all, it looks\rlike a nice place to have a\rpicnic, but there's nothing of\rparticular interest here. No\rintelligent life indicated, and no\rrare or precious materials.

Scans show the actual surface of \rthis planet to be the size of a \rlarge asteroid, but with \rapproximately the same mass as \rEarth. The bulk of what we see is\ran extremely thick layer of toxic\rgases that act as an atmosphere.\rThere are no minerals present that\rare useful to us.

74 percent of the planet's surface\ris covered with snow and ice. They\rappear to be in their own ice age,\ralthough I don't know why I say\r'they.' I have no indications of\rlife anywhere. Any materials we\rcould use would be buried under\rhundreds of feet of ice. It would\rtake us too long to get anything\rout of this place.

The surface of this planet appears\rto be only recently cooling down \rfrom severe volcanic activity.\rThere is no vegetation or\ratmosphere present, and a noxious\rgas is seeping from the cooling\rlava. There are no elements here\rwe can't easily get from another\rplanet.

I can find no traces of water or\rany liquid anywhere on or below\rthe surface of this planet. There\ris no chance for recognizable life\rto have developed here. There\raren't even any precious metals\rburied in the surface. The only\rthing this place would be useful\rfor is a vacation in the desert.

Violent weather patterns appear \reverywhere. A thick cloud cover \rblocks all light to the surface,\rso there are no indications of \rvegetation. Magnetic disturbances\rin the atmosphere make it very \rdangerous, if not impossible, to \rteletrans down.

A very pleasant looking place, \rCaptain. Mostly grass covered with\rlarge, rolling hills and long, \rsweeping plains. The average \rtemperature hovers around 75\rdegrees and there appears to be a\rgentle breeze in the air. No\rintelligent life present.

The surface of this, uh... planet\ris a semi-solid gel. It's a jelly \rworld. Scans show large crystal \rformations, but I don't understand\rwhere the pressure required for \rcrystal growth came from. Nothing \rrecognizable shows up on our \rscanners. I don't think we'll find\rany useful materials down there.

Captain, this planet is very \runstable. Scans indicate 83\rpercent of its crust is constantly\rerupting with volcanic activity\rand the mean air temperature is\rbeyond what any of our\renvironmental suits can compensate\rfor. Nothing of interest here. I\rsuggest we move on.
This world is under the Great\rProtection Treaty signed by the\raffiliates of the Galactic\rEnclave. Seeing that you are not a\rmember we must collect a fee\rbefore you can contact this world.
Greetings, We have been monitoring\ryour situation in the Sol system\rand are very concerned about it.\rOut of sympathy we will reduce the\rvisitation tax for your gallant\rcrew.

Our planetary space lanes are\ramong the safest in the sector but\rwe can't provide these services\rwithout your help.  With a small\rdonation we can continue to bring\ryou the very best in planetary\rsecurity.
WE HAVE SCANNED YOUR VESSEL AND\rDETERMINED THAT YOU MAY POSE A\rTHREAT TO US. WE DEMAND PAYMENT OF\rAN INSURANCE FEE TO ENSURE THE\rGOOD CONDUCT OF YOUR CREW.
As negotiators we have been\rauthorized to charge a settlement\rfee for all those interested in\rviewing this planet.
Your ship has illegally entered\rthis planetary orbital zone. Under\rthe provisions of the Space\rConducts Mandate, Section 2, you\rwill be required to pay a fine\rbefore visitation.
Yearly we have had problems with\rdevelopments of alien viruses\rhere. Because of this we must now\rcharge a new tax to pay for\rimmunization measures. This tax is\rpayable in full before orbiting.
Funds are now being collected for\rthe construction of new planetary\rdefenses. Since this measure is\rnecessitated by alien cultures,\rall aliens must pay a tax before\rentering our orbital space.
You are commanded to remove your\rinferior transports from this\rorbital space immediately or we\rshall be forced to destroy your\rship and all aboard!
Due to a planetary embargo levied\rby the Galactic Enclave,\rvisitation to this planet will not\rbe allowed to any cultures under\rany circumstances.
We are not and will not be\rconsidering any alien races for\rvisitation rights at this time.\rThank you for vacating this space.
In the interest of galactic\rhealth, it would be best if you\rstayed clear of this planet. We\rbelieve that this planet may be\rcontaminated with germ carrying\rspores.
We are currently dealing with an\remergency on the dark side of our\rplanet.  All space traffic is\rordered to vacate immediately!
Puny Earth ship , you are\rcurrently in violation of Space\rConducts Mandate, Sections 13 -\r26. Because of the severity of\ryour violation we cannot allow you\rcontact with this world.
We have already legally claimed\rall visitation privileges to this\rplanet for the next ten years. You\rare ordered to leave or be\rdestroyed!
Attention. We refuse to allow any\rorganic creatures access to this\rworld as they have proven to be\renvironmentally hazardous to\recospheres.  Orbital sanitation\refforts will begin immediately.
Hail, Earth vessel! We are traders\rplying the lonely spaces of the\rvoid. Truly it is a pleasure to\rmeet you. Perhaps we may be able\rto assist one another.

Congratulations on the ingenuity\rof your vessel, aliens. It is rare\rthat we see a vessel of such\rsingular quality and design.\rObviously you are very discerning\rand capable of knowing value. We\rwould like to make you an offer.

It is a sad fact that we must do\rour business here, suspended in\rcold starlight and dead vacuum.\rPerhaps we can meet someday under\rmore pleasant circumstances. I\roffer my humble services as a\rtrader.
Please do not attack. We are a\rpeaceful trading ship on our\rstandard route. I don't have much\rto offer at the moment but I would\rbe willing to work with you.

Many greetings. We have seen much\rand traded heartily in the past\rwith aliens such as yourself. If\rwe might interest you in something\rplease do not hesitate to ask.\rAlways it is desirable to turn a\rprofit.
Is there something we can do for\ryou? We are in a hurry, so we must\rmake this exchange quickly if\rthere is one to be made at all.

Our prices are unfair, exploitive\rand outrageous but we seem to be\rhappy enough with what profits we\rturn. None of our customers have\rever complained about the quality\rof our goods or our information.
Earth ship, you are in violation\rof occupied space! We order you to\rvacate this region immediately or\rbe destroyed.

Ah, Earthlings! We have heard\rabout the mishap with your planet\rand it amuses us. It is our\rsincere hope that you can pilot a\rstarship with more proficiency\rthan you guard a planet. Prepare\rfor battle!
We do not like the way that you\rlook nor the way that you speak.\rTurn your ship towards your star\rhumans and flee if you value your\rlives.
You wish to speak to us? How\rinteresting. It is so rare when\rone gets the opportunity to talk\rwith the dead, for dead is what\ryou very soon shall be if you do\rnot leave the sector immediately.
A battle would please me to no end\rbut I am obligated first to order\ryou to leave. Of course if you\rdecide not to go then we shall\rhave no other choice than to\rfire...

We are targeting your ship for\rdestruction, Earth vessel. A\rpreliminary analysis of your\ractivities has determined that you\rmay be hostile. For the good of\rthe galaxy your ship shall be\rdestroyed.
To battle we fly and our crew is\ryet to be blooded. We shall give\ryou the honor of honing our\rskills. It shall be an honor to\rkill you!
You waddle the space lanes like a\rpregnant Scroe bloodsow!  Perhaps\rit is time that we relieved you of\ra little of your excess weight.\rSurrender your cargo or die!
I enjoy this none more than you\rshall, Earth creatures but these\rtimes have forced my hand...I\rorder that you give over your\rcargo or we shall have to destroy\ryou.

Let's not make this any more\rcomplicated than necessary.  You\rhave something I want and I would\rprefer not to have to destroy you\rto get it. Be civilized and do as\rI say and we shall both be\rhappier.
Your needs are irrelevant Earth\rship. We need the following goods\rand our scans have detected them\raboard your vessel. Give them up\ror you shall be destroyed.

Your weapons are inferior, your\rshields thin and your engines poor\rat best against us. No traders us\rbut the best pirates in this\rspiral arm! Transfer the items we\rdemand and we may spare your\rlives.
No negotiation. Hand over your\rcargo or prepare to meet whatever\rgods you may worship.

It appears that this will be even\reasier than we had hoped!  How\rrefreshing! Arrange to give us\ryour cargo. Of course, if you wish\rto fight, that might provide a\rpleasant diversion as well. It's\ryour choice!

We've prepared you as best we can.\rThere are eight components out there, pieces\rto a puzzle whose solution may mean nothing\rless than the salvation of the Earth itself.\rThese items, the N.I.C.T.U., AlgoCam,\rK-Beam, Harmonic Resonator, Mass Converter,\rGravitic Compressor, Krupp Shields, and\rAlgiebian Crystals, these are all needed to\rreconstruct the Centauri Device. Your search\rcould start nearly anywhere but we have\rdetermined that Alpha Centauri may be the\rbest candidate for first contact because of\ractivity detected there.  Good luck!

Welcome back to Moonbase, crew. Chief\rEngineer Pleadwell has asked that I thank\ryou for the retrieval of the alien technical\rdocuments. Everyone in the Alien\rTechnologies Lab is apparently very excited\rby what they have seen so far and they say\rthat the information seems very promising\rfor us. If you can capture further alien\ritems for us, we may begin to duplicate\rtheir laser-based weapons as well as some\rother higher tech objects. Keep up the good\rwork.

Always a pleasure to see you back here in\rone piece, team! Again Maria Pleadwell\rthanks you for retrieving these new alien\rtechnical documents. It took a little while\rlonger for us to wade through all the data\rbut it appears to be as valuable as the last\rclutch of documents you brought us.\rAssuming we have all the proper elements and\rprototypes to work from, we may be able to\rproduce even heavier weapons for you to use.\rKeep this up and we'll be as advanced as the\rmost advanced races in the galaxy!

I can tell that this mission is beginning\rto wear on you, but hang in there. As long\ras you can keep bringing us back these\rtechnical documents, we can build better\rships and weapons for you.  You'll be\rpleased to know that the latest technical\rplans that you brought back are fantastic!\rAlien Technologies thinks they can vastly\rimprove the efficiency of the technologies\rwe already possess and at the same time add\ra few new items to our Replicator's data\rbanks.  How's that for good news!

We thought that we knew everything there was\rto know until you brought us the latest\rbatch of technical plans! I don't know if\ryou have had a chance to look them over, but\rwhat we've seen so far is elegant enough to\rbe frightening.  The list of subjects reads\rlike a Christmas List for the Alien\rTechnologies Lab: Microgravitics, Non-Linear\rWave Propagating, Offensive Teletransing...\rWe should be able to manufacture weapons\rthat match the most powerful things that we\rhave seen!

Congratulations on the retrieval of the\rAlgiebian Crystal, team! The Reconstruction\rpeople say that it will provide the power\rfor the Centauri Device once fully\rreconstructed. Of course that depends on you\rbringing us more parts! Before you leave,\ryou might want to know that Intelligence\rsays that Kornephoros Sector may be a good\rplace to look next if you haven't already\rventured there.  Tactically we should be\rcapable of handling them.

Now that you've brought back the Gravitic\rCompressor, we're another step closer to\rgetting the Earth back from limbo! We\rhaven't had a chance to hook it up yet but\rit is very similar to the alien technology\rthat we've encountered so far. There\rshouldn't be any problems. Incidentally, you\rmay want to check out a disturbance in the\rAlhena sector. There seems to be a lot of\ractivity going on there.

The Reconstruction Team wanted me to relay\rtheir thanks for the retrieval of the Mass\rConverter. It operates much like a large\rscale Teletrans but we're not entirely\rcertain what its purpose is when the\rCentauri Device is activated. In other news,\rwe're receiving a lot of chatter from Caroli\rSector. One of our decoders thinks that he\rheard something about a Gravitic Compressor!

Great work, team. The Algo Cam you've   \rbrought us is a very important part of the\rdevice. I only wish I knew enough about it\rto tell you what it does. Oh well, that's\rwhat the guys in the lab get paid for.\rReconstruction of the alien device is\rprogressing very nicely and all of here at\rMoonbase are very hopeful that we will be\rable to recover our lost planet. By the\rway the people in the Research Lab would\rlike to see you when you have the time.

It appears as though we can cross the\rHarmonic Resonator off the list of items\rthat we need! Very well done, crew! After\rgoing over the device and comparing it to\rthe alien schematic, we know that this\rdevice actually generates the wave that will\ropen the wormhole door! And while I'm on the\rsubject, we have detected a wormhole like\rdisturbance in Izar Sector. Maybe you can\rfind some answers there.

The K-Beam that you delivered is quite a\rtoy! It's like a gravitational grappling\rhook that the Centauri Device will use to\rstabilize the dimensional door. Needless to\rsay, the Reconstruction team was very\rpleased with it! Intelligence has been\rcombing through the ETS and they definitely\rknow that you can get a Harmonic Resonator\rsomewhere in Sector Ankaq. Watch yourself\rthough, it's a fairly advanced sector.

As always, your efforts are outstanding!\rNow that we have the N.I.C.T.U. in place we\rare much closer to having the Centauri\rDevice reconstructed. Hopefully we can start\rsimulations studies on it soon. As\rdistasteful a duty as it may seem, I want to\rask you to try to explore the Alnasl Sector\rif you have not done so already. The\rtechnology evident there seems very similar\rto that of the wrecked ETS!

The Krupp Shields that you retrieved appear\rto be in very good condition.  We will\rinstall it on the Centauri Device prototype\ras soon as we finish some last minute\radjustments to it. In the meanwhile, you may\rwant to venture into Sector Ankaq.  I have\rconferred with Wade and we think that we\rshould be able to face the pirates in that\rsector with a small modicum of risk. I wish\ryou all well.

When once I landed on Talitha 2, a\rlocal trader told me of a secret\rpath that led through the bush\rgardens and wound its way to an\rentrance in the side of the\rbuilding.  The path is surrounded\rby danger, so be careful.

They Who Converse are strange ones\rindeed. The only way to talk to\rthem is by using a thing they call\ran Imastyl. If you ever find\ryourself on Subra 2, just look\raround the trees and you're bound\rto find one.  You'll hold no\ruseful dialogue without it.

KooShee 1 is a dank and lonely \rplace. I once was there with three\rshipmates and we were immediately \rseparated for the longest time, \rleaving me to search them out. If \rthis fate should befall you,\rsearch for the secret door at the\redge of the stream. I never found\rit myself, but I hear rumors of a\rspecial mirror shard lost in the\rcorridors.

The Hall of Shame, in the \rPresidential Complex on Algeiba 4,\rcontains a single bust with eyes \rmade of Algeiban Crystals. If you \rcan deactivate the force field,\rthey will be yours. Good luck to\ryou. I finally gave up.

Never before have I seen the likes\rof you among the stars. Your kind \rmust be new to deep space travel. \rAllow me to offer some advice...\rTry to communicate with whoever\ryou come across. If their\rintentions are hostile, you'll\rknow it soon enough.  And take\rheed to what you are told.  Seldom\rwill you be purposefully mislead.

Here's a piece of advice for you\rin a combat situation. Concentrate\ryour firepower on a single enemy\runtil it is destroyed. Spreading\ryourself too thin while in battle\rwill only shorten your stay with\rus among the stars.
Don't worry if you are having a \rdifficult time knowing where to\rgo.  You are new here. Follow\rmerchant ships to find new places\rto explore.
Pirates are a problem all over.\rYou can shoot them out of the\rstars all you want, but you have\rto blow up their base to rid a\rsector of their presence.

This may be a handy piece of\radvice if you happen to find\ryourself lost in the sewers of\rRutilicus 2. Each of the levers\rthere make the walls shift. And\rwatch out for the green slime.\rIt's toxic to your kind.

Eltanin 7 is always having\rproblems with their communications\rarray. They can't keep the snow\roff it long enough to maintain\rcontact. Why they would want to\rlive there I'll never know. Find\rthe array and use a Thermaul to\rclear it. That should enable their\rcommunications system.

I had a nasty time of it on Sabik\r1 a year ago, trying to find my\rway around. These infernal levers\rwith words are on the walls\reverywhere. Switch the levers so\rthey form a certain sentence and\rthe locked elevator door will let\ryou in.
The Dantea on Sabik I eat Skocha\rroots to make their bodies\rtolerant to radiation. They value\rSkocha higher than Diamonds.

The most powerful weapon in the \runiverse lies entombed in the \rsepulchres of Kornephoros 3.\rSearch for it in the central tomb\rof the Last Defenders Tomb Room.\rYou will need to find the last\rstanza of the Defender's Tale to\robtain your prize.

Here's a little tip for you I\rpicked up after years of pirat...\reh, trading in this sector. The\rTrader Warehouse on Kochab 2 has a\rprivate and secret room in it\rwhere you will be able to acquire\rsome very helpful things. Use the\rUnilock to get in.

Search out new technology in each \rsector of space you explore. There\rare tech plans for new ships and \rweapons to be found in most. It\rwill be the key to your survival\ras you unravel the mysteries of\rthe universe.
If you find a weapon made at a \rhigher tech level than you have \rreached, use it sparingly. You\rwill be unable to duplicate the\rweapon until you reach that tech\rlevel.

You need a Work Permit to do \ranything useful on Alula 4. If\rasked to find some Lozam to prove\ryour worth, there's some hidden on\ra flower pot. I put it there so if\rI ever returned I'd be able to get\ra permit quickly. Feel free to use\rit if you wish, but I don't\rremember exactly which pot it's in\rso you'll have to do a little\rsearching.

The Zoo on Merak 1 is an\rinteresting place to spend some\rtime, but you need to have an\rengineer with you to operate the\rteleport pads. They're just a\rlittle too complicated for the\ranimal of average intelligence.

I worked in the Miniaturization\rLab on Cor-Caroli 1 some time ago.\rBlasted thing was always breaking \rdown. Always had to drop in a gold\rwire to fix a break in the\rcircuit, then switch two of the\rchips to make the machine work. I\rbet they never even fixed those\rproblems.

Have you ever been to the temple\ron Denebola 4? It is full of those\rsleeping Eldarin beasts. Horrible \rlooking creatures. And you sure \rdon't want to be around when they \rcome out of hibernation. To leave \rthe temple you must operate a \rstrange lock and key mechanism\rmade up of orbs and pillars.

There are sixteen different\rminerals to be found out here in\rspace. Minerals that must be used\rto manufacture the new\rtechnologies you will come across.\rYou will have to search out the\rmore exotic ones.
Build specific applications into\rthe design of your ships. Make\rseparate ships for war,\rexploration, and freighting. Too\rmuch generalization will leave you\rweak and vulnerable.

To stay alive out here, temper\ryour reactions to unexpected\rsituations.  Fight when it is\rnecessary to fight, but run when\rit is best to do so. You cannot\rsave your planet unless you can\rsave yourself. If you are not\rstrong enough to face a foe, run\raway and return when you are more \rpowerful.
Be choosey when cloning\rreplacements for your crew. Accept\ronly specimens that are highly\rskilled for your weapons.

Heed my warning. Do not visit \rProcyon 3 until there is great \rstrength in your weapons and\rarmor.  There is much of danger to\rbe found there. If you look long\renough you will find a Battle\rLaser, one way or another.

The keeper of the Leader's Stone\rwas last known to be on a cruise\rpassing by Capella 1, but no\rcontact has been made with the\rship in some time. The Leader's\rStone is necessary for your tasks,\rso you may wish to search for it.

The Claims Officer on Alhena 8 is\ra forgetful fellow. He's always \rmisplacing his validation stamp,\rand what's worse is he drops it in\rthe same place every time. If you\rneed him to validate a deed,\rchances are you'll have to find\rhis stamp first.  A flight\rrecorder will open the door to\rwhere he loses it.
The doors of the diplomatic\rstation on Hyades 1 are operated\rby slider panels found on the\rwalls. This information may prove\ruseful if ever you need to go\rthere.

Use grenades with caution. They\rare very effective against groups\rof foes, but watch your range.\rGrenades work just as effectively\ragainst any of your own people who\rget caught in the blast area.
There is solidarity among beings\ron planets. If you fire at a\rbeing, others within sight are\rlikely to come to its aid. It may\rbe best to do your killing in dark\rcorners.
If there is a starbase in a\rsector, it may be worth checking\rout. Bases are seldom established\rin areas where there is nothing of\rvalue to protect.

Bases and their escorts do not\rhave to be destroyed in one\rattack. If need be, and it \rprobably will, you may retreat to \rrepair your damage and return to \rfinish your devastation. What\rships you have destroyed will\rstill be gone.
Any fool knows that you should use\ra Sonic Pinchers on pipes that are\rjutting from walls.

The jungle planet of RasalMothal 5\ris in terrible danger of being \rdevastated by storms. Inside the \rpyramid is the key to calming the \rweather. In the jungle there is a \rmaintenance shed. Fix the wires\rthat have been chewed on by Slieth\rto enter the pyramid.

On RasalMothal 5 there is a square\rarea of strange design outside the\rcontrol room. You must manipulate \rthe tiles of the square to look\rlike a claw-shaped ship to gain\raccess to the control room.

The domes of Zaurak 2 are full of \rteleports. It is very easy to get \rlost while popping around. It may\rbe wise to drop objects to mark\rwhere you've already been. When\ryou find the pumping station, a\rspecial tool must be used to\rreactivate the water supply.

On Diphda 4 they play a nasty game\rcalled Scorch. Only the bravest \rplay, for pain is the penalty for \rlosing. Very few beat the machine.\rBut... I know a way to win. There\ris a switch buried somewhere in\rthe snow outside. Throw the switch\rand the Scorch machine will throw\rthe game.
Go see the Giate on Rana. He will \rtell you of the needs of this \rsector. His words must be followed\rto neutralize the white dwarf that\ris threatening this sector.

Greetings, Humans. I have some \rinformation that may set your\rminds at ease, at least for the\rtime being. Our latest scans show\rthat your planet is still safe and\rintact. We wish you luck on your \rquest to reclaim it.

If your knowledge is not great \renough to carry you through the \rtasks that lie ahead, there are \rlegendary beings of great\rintellect that may be called upon\rto give assistance. They can be\rreached by your standard\rtelecommunications consoles. Their\raccess code is (818) 999-0607.
If you should need to get into the\rtemple on Ankaq 1, pay tribute to \rthe Queen Muniarc on Fomalhaut 6. \rShe will give you the key you\rneed.

In the temple on Ankaq 1, the \rspheres of Awa, Themi, Ryth and \rHarmon have been stolen away and \rscattered throughout this sector. \rThey must be returned to their \rproper resting places in the\rfloor.  While on Ankaq you may\rwish to look for the Comnet which\rwas lost there.

Shadowside is a dark world of \rintrigue. The Cyberpunks and the \rTschi Tai are always looking to\rgain advantage over each other.\rHeed these three things - Take\rEinjhi Codebreaker's translations\rto Bit. If you find any wetware,\rtake it to Socketball. Find\rwet suits for your group. They may\rbe needed later.

Nashira 3 is a shimmering place of\renticing waters. Don't try to swim\rwithout a wet suit or you will be \rforever lost in the lightless, \rbottomless deep. But you will need\rto swim to find the real life and \rcivilization of this wet world.
On Nashira 3, the only way to\rescape with the Sphere of Themi is\rto leave a counterfeit sphere in\rits place. The Seadudes are too\rstupid to know the difference.
On Alrai 2, in the chambers of CU,\rthere is a picture hanging on the \rwall. Search this picture closely \rand a hidden passage may be \rrevealed.

In this sector there once lived a \rmerchant who grew very rich by \rselling video entertainment to \rintelligent beings. He was loved\rby all. Then one day Pirates came\rand copied his goods and\rdistributed them freely throughout\rthe galaxy. As a result of this\rthievery, the merchant's wife and\rchildren died of starvation and he\rhimself now lives a destitute life\ras a broken man.
Dangerous for your kind, is this \rplace. Last long will you not. \rPowerful ships you need, but slow \rthey will become. He he he he...

Arcturas III is trapped in the \rdarker ages of fear and ignorance.\rWhen you come across the four rows\rof chests, open three lids in the \rfirst row, three in the second\rrow, all lids in the third row,\rand the prize in the last row will\rbe yours.

I have been patrolling this sector\rfor a long time. There is little \rthat remains hidden from me. Mizar\r5 may be of particular interest to\ryou. There are two prizes to be \rfound there - the Cevitic Balancer\rand a Hataphas gem.
The only way to enter the main\rcomplex on Ascella II is to use\ran Escape Code.  Be warned, if you\rdare to go there, buy life\rinsurance and lots of it.

Be wary on Izar 2. Truth, there,\ris of vital importance, for no one\rknows the plans of the Concierge. \rUse the Star Stones of Arcturas\rIII to travel past the pockmarked\rwall.  Remember, always answer\rtruthfully what you are asked.
There are radioactive piles on\rIzar 2 that could prove very\rhazardous to beings such as\ryourselves. They can be safely\rcleared away by using a Pickor.

New growth takes place on \rVindemiatrix 1. The Concierge is \rfully behind it, though none can \rfathom his reasons for it. It is \rrumored that there once was a\rdirect teletrans between the new\rcolony and Izar 2. That's a far\rpiece of space to jump across.
The key to the most powerful\rweapon in the universe can be\rfound in this sector. Watch\ryourself if you use it, it packs\rquite a punch and kicks like a\rmule.
Don't anger the Concierge, he is\rvery powerful and VERY dangerous\rwhen angered!

If you find yourself on Alnasl 1, \rthe Ominar will undoubtedly try to\renlist your aid. Be careful that\ryou use the proper Strandware on\rthe correct Ominar. And you may\rneed to visit Cor-Caroli 1 to find\rthe Microtic Injector needed to \radminister the Strandware.

The Ominar are very intelligent \rcreatures. Many of their control \rmechanisms are difficult to \runderstand. These two things are \rknown to be used on Vega 9: NaCl, \rwhat you call salt, and H2So4,\rwhich you have a most peculiar\rname for. They will grant you\raccess to many things, as will a\rcertain key on Alnasl 1.

Heed this warning, humans. Do not \rattempt to infiltrate Ascella 2.\rIf you do go there, you will need\rto have the most advanced weapons \ravailable, but even then your \rchances of survival are too low to\rcalculate. Knowing the escape \rsequence may be your only hope.
You must possess the most powerful\rweapons to survive in this sector.\rEven then your lives are worth\rvery little. Don't even think of \rexploring these planets without\rmega war abilities.
Primitive weapons work best\ragainst the Ominar. Keep low tech\rlevel items in your packs when\rdescending on Ascella 2.
I speak Human goodly. My nose is \rshaky but my hair stops cars. Do\ryou have a social consideration?\rMy Chihuahua is inside-out, I must\rsay.
You are very close to completing\rthe construction of your "Cygnus\rCanon." There is but one component\rmissing, and you will find it\rhere.

Do you really think it's a good\ridea to use the Cygnus Canon? This\rtechnology is new to you. Have you\rforgotten what happened when smart\rcreatures tried to use it? Why\rdon't you just find a nice planet \rsomewhere safe and take it over\rfor yourselves. Cut your losses.

Mason Polk here, Moonbase commander. There\ris some concern about hostile aliens\rduplicating the Ulysses Exploration Team\rwith the intent of infiltrating the \rdatabanks of Moonbase and sabotaging\rinformation critical to the construction of\rthe Centauri Device. Please confirm your\ridentity by referring to your U.N.F.A. \rmanual and typing in the [ word on page\r|.]

The Calypso class starcruiser detailed in\rthese tech plans is a drastic improvement\rover our own Ulysses class exploration\rvessel.  An improvement on the power\refficiency curve allows for greater armament\rand more engine mountings. Moonbase\rEngineers tell me we will be able to mount\rfive weapons and five engine pods on the\rhull. You should notice a definite increase\rin speed.

The information in these ship plans offers\ran improvement on the Calypso class\rstarcruiser, doubling the number of weapons\rmounts possible. The increased hull size\rallows for two additional engine pods and\rgreater cargo storage. I personally named\rthis hull type the Sheroshu, and if I hear\rone more person say 'gesundheit' I'll kick\rthem out of U.N.F.A. myself.

Like the Sheroshu class, these starcruiser\rtech readouts allow for ten weapon mountings\rand seven engine pods. However, the great\rbulk of the hull design may cut back a\rlittle on the speed of the ship, depending\ron how you decide to equip her. The\rengineers decided to name this hull design\rthe Kerouac. Don't ask me what it's supposed\rto mean, you know how it is when tech people\rtry to be creative.

After carefully studying the tech plans and\rreferring to the data retrieved from the\rETS, Moonbase Engineers have determined that\rthe present number of armament and engine\rpods cannot be exceeded. It appears the\radvances in design detailed in these plans\rinvolve increased storage capacity and \rgreater shield protection. I worked with the\rengineers this time and we decided to name\rthis hull Harbinger.

The hull type specified in these tech plans\rshould further increase your storage\rcapacity. Moonbase Engineers have overcome\rsome problems with the alien technology and\rI believe your shield protection can be\rboosted as well.  She may be a little slow,\rbut this ship should hold her own out there.\rThe boys in the communications center have \rnicknamed this design the Tempest.

Moonbase Engineers wanted to call this ship\rdesign the space slug. That may give you an\ridea of what to expect in the way of speed\rand maneuverability. But she's a sturdy\rship, and you can arm her to the teeth. This\ris the boat I'd want to take into an all-out\rbattle. Lots of shields, lots of fire. Who\rneeds to move fast when you're blowing the\renemy away? I call her Fury.

Hello, team. As you may already suspect,\ryour genetic predecessors have died in the\rline of duty.  Fortunately the\rreconnaissance teams that we sent out were\rable to recover everything that the previous\rContact team gathered.  You may note slight\rdifferences in your abilities, but you are,\rafter all clones. We cannot caution you\renough that although you may have William,\rNelson, Osai and Katya's memories, you are\rin many ways different people.  Please be\rcareful in the future.
